mapper.update: UPDATE wkf_supply_request SET status_enum = #{statusEnum}, applicant_id = #{applicantId}, apply_time = #{applyTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE bus_no = #{busNo} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status_enum = 'DRAFT'

mapper.select: SELECT bus_no, MAX(status_enum) AS status_enum, MAX(created_by) AS created_by, MAX(created_at) AS created_at, MAX(approver_id) AS approver_id, MAX(approval_time) AS updated_at, SUM(COALESCE(total_price, 0)) AS total_price FROM wkf_supply_request WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY bus_no ORDER BY MAX(created_at) DESC
SELECT MAX(bus_no) FROM wkf_supply_request WHERE is_deleted = 0
